content_sections.heading: NIT Srinagar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Chemical Engineering: B.E. / B. Tech in Chemical Engineering and M.E. / M. Tech with Ph.D. First class at Bachelor's and Master's level. Metallurgical & Materials Engineering: B.E. / B. Tech in Metallurgical & Materials Engineering and M.E. / M. Tech with Ph.D. First class at Bachelor's and Master's level.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Srinagar?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Temporary Teaching Staff posts at NIT Srinagar is scheduled for 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by NIT Srinagar?
faq.answer: NIT Srinagar has released a total of 2 vacancies for the Temporary Teaching Staff positions in the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the NIT Srinagar recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline, with a first class at both Bachelor's and Master's levels.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Temporary Teaching Staff posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Temporary Teaching Staff positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 65,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the NIT Srinagar recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for the NIT Srinagar jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these positions is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. Which departments have vacancies for Temporary Teaching Staff at NIT Srinagar?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in Chemical Engineering and Metallurgical & Materials Engineering departments.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Srinagar located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Srinagar is located in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 190006.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation mentioned for the NIT Srinagar recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for these posts.
